brief:
Israeli forces released Palestinian prisoner Amir Adli Jarrar from Jenin following two years of detention in Israeli prisons, Eye on Palestine reported. Jarrar's return to his hometown marked the end of an extended period in custody within the Israeli prison system.

The release came as Palestinians continue to face ongoing detention and incarceration. Details surrounding the specific reasons for Jarrar's detention, the circumstances of his release, or any negotiations preceding it were not provided in available accounts.
